title: Tablet of Experience
description: Store your experience points in a mysterious Ancient Tablet and withdraw them later!
body:
Tablet of Experience adds a single new item: the **Ancient Tablet**, a relic themed around the Ancient City that lets you bank experience and retrieve it later when you need it.

### Features

- Stores up to 100 levels of experience with a bar to show how much is stored
- Store experience on right click (can be done multiple times as long as the tablet still has space)
- Retrieve experience on sneak + right click
- Tablet cracks after each retrieval and breaks after three

### Recipe
8 Deepslate and 1 Echo Shard:

![Ancient Tablet Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca5210a8581c6e7b2b60e390feac690159f07775.png)

This mod may be used in any modpack provided it is distributed via CurseForge or Modrinth and links to the official project page. Redistribution of the jar file elsewhere is not permitted.
